stakes: The Ducks go in third in the Pacific with 23 points, the Mammoth tied for fifth in the Central with 25 points.

UTA.head: The matchup suits the Mammoth
UTA.body: Even though Utah will be without Keller, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. On top of that, Anaheim will be without Sennecke. The Ducks can make it interesting if their power play gets going.

ANA.head: The Ducks face a real test
ANA.body: Even though Utah will be without Keller, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. On top of that, Anaheim will be without Sennecke. The Ducks’ best way through is a power play that gets going.

story.head: The Mammoth are going to test Ville Husso early and often
paras: The Ducks (11-11-1) lost 4-0 to Colorado on Thursday, while the Mammoth (11-9-3) beat Colorado 4-1 on Wednesday. Going in, the Ducks are third in the Pacific (19th in the NHL) and the Mammoth fifth in the Central (tied for 15th).

The Ducks’ record (.500) is about what their chances are worth. The Mammoth have played better than their record (.543) says: their chances are worth about .706, and their goaltending has held them back.

The Ducks play fast, open games (4th), give up a lot of dangerous shots (31st) and have had shaky goaltending (30th). Anaheim has allowed 3.87 goals a game, the third most in the league. On the other side, the Mammoth rarely get pinned in their own end (1st), let the point shots come and guard the net (1st) and get more of their shots from in close than almost anyone (3rd). The Mammoth are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Ducks. Beyond that, both teams like to hit, so expect plenty of it.

Cutter Gauthier (21 G / 8 A / 29 P in 22 GP) leads the Ducks in scoring and is tied for tenth in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games. Leo Carlsson (6 G / 22 A / 28 P in 23 GP) is next in line. Clayton Keller (5 G / 24 A / 29 P in 23 GP) leads the Mammoth in scoring and is tied for tenth in the NHL, with six goals in nine games against Anaheim since 2023-24. Logan Cooley (11 G / 12 A / 23 P in 20 GP) has a team-high eleven goals.
Ville Husso (3-4-0 / .857 SV% in 6 GS) has had a rough start to the season for Anaheim, but is expected to start. Sebastian Cossa (5-2-1 / .879 SV% in 8 GS) is expected to go for Utah.

At home, André Tourigny likes to send Carcone, McBain and Crouse out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Gauthier, Carlsson and Caulfield. One more thing: the Mammoth usually control more of the chances than the Ducks do.

items.text: The Ducks are newly without Beckett Sennecke, and have been without A.J. Greer and Laurent Brossoit for several games. Ville Husso is expected to start.

The Mammoth have been without Nate Schmidt, John Marino and Nick Schmaltz for several games. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, no team is missing more right now.
Drew Helleson has missed the Ducks’ latest game.
Cutter Gauthier has 20 goals on chances worth about 9.7 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
